remarks: **HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS BY MONDAY, MARCH 10th at 5:00pm**  Welcome to 16 Bouton Street West! Calling all investors and dream home seekers-this gem is ready for your personal touch. Whether you're an investor looking for your next project or someone eager to create their dream home. This property is being sold "AS IS" and is ready for your creativity. Bring your vision and transform this house into the home you've always wanted! Walk to train, shopping, restaurants and much more! Easy access to Parkway.
